image.picturesLeftOut: Some pictures were not added. Copy a picture on its own to paste it.

attachment.localOnlyTip: Doesn't fit in your storage. Not backed up - clearing browser/app data deletes it. It syncs once space frees.
attachment.notUploadedTip: This file hasn't been uploaded from the device it was added on - usually because storage is full there. It opens here once it syncs.
attachment.damaged: This file could not be opened. It may be damaged.

viewer.pdfFailed: Can't open this PDF. Download it to open it in another app.
viewer.pdfPassword: This PDF has a password. Download it to open it in another app.
viewer.saveFailed: Saving failed, so the file may be empty or incomplete.

mail.failed: Can't read this email. Download it to open it in another app.

picker.title: Pictures in Files
picker.empty: No pictures in Files yet. Upload one there, then add it here.
picker.noCopy: A picture you add here points to the file in Files, so it takes up no extra storage.

dragCorner: Drag a corner to fix the edge
insertTextDesc: Only the words, as plain text
scanFirstPageOnly: Only the first page was added. Scan each page on its own.
addTextGone: This text can no longer be added to the note. Copy it instead.
firstRun: Getting ready, the first time takes longer
noText: No text found in this picture.
longAudio: This takes about as long as the recording. Keep the app open.
audioFormat: This audio format is not supported.
audioTooLong: This recording is longer than one hour. Voice to text reads up to one hour.
appleLanguage: Your device downloads this language from Apple first.
appleNoLanguage: This language is not available on this device.
appleTooMany: Too many speech languages on this device. Remove one in the system settings.
lowMemoryWarn: This device may not have enough memory for this.
lowMemory: Not enough memory on this device. Close other apps and try again.
cleanFailed: Could not remove the noise from this recording.
